statement: Whenever max_active_sections_after_trade(s, queries) returns a result out, len(out) = m and for every i with 0 <= i < m the following holds. Let ones(s) = #{j | 0 <= j < n and s[j] = 49}. Call a pair (a,b) an i-trade-block if l_i < a <= b < r_i, s[j] = 49 for every j with a <= j <= b, s[a-1] = 48, and s[b+1] = 48. For an i-trade-block (a,b), let L_i(a,b) = max { L >= 0 | a - L >= l_i and s[a-h] = 48 for every h with 1 <= h <= L } and R_i(a,b) = max { R >= 0 | b + R <= r_i and s[b+h] = 48 for every h with 1 <= h <= R }. Let G_i = max( {0} union { L_i(a,b) + R_i(a,b) | (a,b) is an i-trade-block } ). Then out[i] = ones(s) + G_i.
preconditions: Let n = len(s) and m = len(queries). Assume 1 <= n <= 100000. For every j with 0 <= j < n, s[j] is the ASCII byte for '0' (48) or '1' (49). Assume 1 <= m <= 100000. For every i with 0 <= i < m, len(queries[i]) = 2; write l_i = queries[i][0] and r_i = queries[i][1] as integers, and assume 0 <= l_i <= r_i < n.
